item.title: Obituary - Ricky "Rick" Cantrell Jr.
item.description: Ricky "Rick" Cantrell Jr. age 58 of Harrisonville, Missouri departed this life Tuesday, January 6, 2026 at his home in Harrisonville, Missouri. Cremation with a celebration of life service will be held at a later date. A complete obituary will be posted once that information becomes available, courtesy Dickey Funeral Home.

item.title: Obituary - Nettie Louise Chadd
item.description: Nettie Louise Chadd, 71, passed away on Wednesday, January 7, 2026, at her home in Milo, MO. Nettie was born on April 17, 1954, in Joplin, MO to Warden and Laura (Cartwright) Pate. She married Glenn R. Chadd on December 24, 1983, and he survives of the home. Nettie grew up in Louisiana and Nevada, MO. She was a graduate of Nevada High School. item.title: Cold front inbound
item.description: A cold front is pushing through the region. Overnight in the upper 30's, with 40's for a high on Friday. Winter weather advisory already out for SW Kansas. Snow will be heaviest there tomorrow.

item.title: Harrisonville police issue scam alert
item.description: We have received a report that someone is calling citizens and identifying themselves as a member of the Harrisonville Police Department. The scammer is relaying identifying information to the person (address) in an attempt to make the person believe they are an officer and the call is legitimate. item.title: Obituary - Gary Lee Martin
item.description: Gary Lee Martin of Mountain Home, Arkansas, passed away December 18, 2025, in Mountain Home, Arkansas at the age of 72. He was born October 11, 1953, in Kansas City, Missouri, the son of James Lee Martin. Gary was a U.S. Army veteran during the time of the Vietnam War. He went on to serve his community as a police officer in St. Clair and Bates counties for 25 years. item.title: Butler Chamber welcomes Scooter's Coffee
item.description: The Butler Area Chamber of Commerce welcomed Scooter's Coffee with an official ribbon cutting held this morning. There was plenty of excitement as free coffee and special deals are offered, ushering in the new business. Scooter's is located next to Burger King on west 52 highway and you can follow them on Facebook here https://www.facebook.com/ScootersCoffee2527
